paragraphs: JC James Remodeling does bathroom remodeling Point Pleasant homeowners describe with one word again and again: perfectionist. It is the most mentioned topic in the Google reviews, right alongside tile and how neat the work site is kept.

Jeff James does the work from start to finish. One homeowner had him turn an empty closet into a full second bathroom, with new water and sewer lines, vanity, toilet, tiled shower stall, tiled walls and floor, and trim. Another hired him to tile a shower, and when he found the old plumbing had not been done properly he fixed it, even though it meant a longer day. Customers also say he never left a mess.

items.name: Complete bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Everything a bathroom needs, handled by one person: water lines, sewer line, sink, vanity, medicine cabinet, toilet, tiled shower, tiled walls and floor, and trim. Jeff has even turned an empty closet into a beautiful second bathroom.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with white double vanity, two mirrors and brown glass mosaic tile wall

items.name: Tiled showers
items.blurb: Subway tile, marble-look porcelain, mosaic bands, niches and corner shelves. Reviewers call the tile work great and amazing, with a lot of attention to detail, and tiled is one of the most mentioned words in the reviews.

image.alt: Shower walls in white subway tile with corner shelves and brushed nickel handheld shower

items.name: Tile walls and floors
items.blurb: Feature walls, floors and accent bands, like the full-height glass mosaic wall behind a double vanity shown here. Large-format floor tile and mosaic accents are set straight and neat, so the room looks finished from every angle.

image.alt: Close-up of black, grey and clear glass mosaic accent tile in a shower

items.name: Plumbing done right
items.blurb: Because Jeff runs water and sewer lines himself, problems behind the wall get fixed rather than covered. During one shower job he discovered the existing plumbing had not been done properly and corrected it, even though it meant working longer that day.

image.alt: Finished subway tile shower with glass mosaic accent band and recessed niche

items.title: Never 'good enough'
items.text: One customer wrote that Jeff never had the attitude of 'that's good enough'. Perfectionist is mentioned in four reviews, and it shows in the finished rooms.

items.title: A clean, neat job
items.text: Reviewers say he works clean and they never came home to a mess. The only trace of him, one wrote, was a bathroom more complete than the day before.

items.title: One person, every trade
items.text: Plumbing, vanity, toilet, tile and trim are all done by Jeff, so nothing falls between trades and you always know who is responsible for the work.

items.title: On schedule, as agreed
items.text: Customers say all work was scheduled and performed on time and as agreed, and that Jeff came out to give a quote as soon as he was free.

about.text: JC James Remodeling LLC is a bathroom remodeler serving Monmouth and Ocean County, New Jersey, with more than 20 years of experience. Its motto is simple: Quality Service at All Times. Jeff James is the name in every review. He takes the time to understand what you want to accomplish, then does the job himself, from the plumbing to the last piece of trim. Homeowners call him helpful, knowledgeable and easy to work with, and several have said they would hire him again for their next project.

items.name: Luann P.
items.text: I am very happy with the quality of work performed by Jeff James on my bathroom remodeling.  He transformed an empty closet into a beautiful second bathroom.  He did everything from start to finish, which included the installation of the water lines, sewer line, sink, vanity, medicine cabinet, toilet, tiled shower stall, tiled walls and floor, and trim.  He really took pride in his work and never had the attitude of "that's good enough".  He was very helpful throughout the project and took the time to understand what I was looking to accomplish.  He is a perfectionist and it showed in the final product!  All work was scheduled and performed timely and as agreed.  He never left a mess and the only trace of him being there was that the bathroom was more complete than the day before.  I will definitely hire him for future projects....I highly recommend that you do too!

items.name: Amanda G.
items.text: I would highly recommend Jeff to anyone who needed work done. He answered me and came out to give me a quote as soon as he was free. We had our shower tiled and he was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job with a lot of attention to detail. During the job he discovered our plumbing was not done properly and he corrected the issue, even if it meant he has to spend longer that day working. We love our new shower so much !

items.name: Lisa J.
items.text: Very easy to work with and he works clean, never came home to a mess.  Great tile work.  Would definitely recommend.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Point Pleasant and the Jersey Shore
service_area.text: JC James Remodeling is listed on Google in Point Pleasant, New Jersey, and serves homeowners across Monmouth County and Ocean County. Jeff comes to your home to look at the bathroom and give you a free estimate. If you are in either county and want to know whether your town is on the list, call (732) 840-4456, Monday through Saturday.

items.q: Do you handle the plumbing, or just the tile?
items.a: Both. On one remodel Jeff installed the water lines, sewer line, sink, vanity, medicine cabinet, toilet, tiled shower stall, tiled walls and floor, and trim. On a shower job he found the existing plumbing had not been done properly and corrected it before finishing the tile.

items.q: Can you add a bathroom where there isn't one?
items.a: It has been done. One homeowner had Jeff transform an empty closet into a beautiful second bathroom, with new supply and sewer lines run to it. Every house is different, so call to talk about the space you have in mind and we will come out and look.

Yes. JC James Remodeling offers free estimates. Call (732) 840-4456 or email jcjamesllc3@gmail.com. One customer wrote that Jeff answered and came out to give her a quote as soon as he was free, so you will not be left waiting long for a reply.

We serve Monmouth County and Ocean County in New Jersey, and the business is listed on Google in Point Pleasant. If you are not sure whether your town is covered, give us a call with your address and a quick description of the bathroom and we will let you know.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday. Saturday hours make it easier to set up an estimate if you work during the week. Call (732) 840-4456 during those hours to reach Jeff.

final_cta.h2: Ready for a bathroom done right?
final_cta.text: Call Jeff for a free estimate on your shower, tile or full bathroom remodel.
